source.note: Original Lightweight leg-day carousel, part three of the Push/Pull/Legs series. Uses approved LW-CAR-0002 as the exact visual template.

visual_templates.all_slides: carousels/LW-CAR-0002/outputs/slide-01.png through slide-09.png; slides 1-8 mapped as specified in codex-task.md.

slides.prompt:
Create ONE finished original Lightweight carousel slide, LW-CAR-0009 slide 1, using the attached owner-approved LW-CAR-0002 slide 1 as the exact composition and style reference. This is the third part of our own Push/Pull/Legs series. Match the approved cover's 4:5 layout, position and scale of the three stacked display lines, pale arch, background, exact small wordmark location, fine anatomy illustration style, and lower-half equipment figure. Use Rubik for all text, heaviest weight for the three cover lines. Leave the top-left wordmark area clear for the exact supplied logo to be composited; do not redraw or invent it. No border, caption, watermark, signature or other text.

Palette: background #F0F1EB; large pale coral arch rising on the right #FBE3DD; dark headline #2A2A2A; coral headline and highlighted muscles #F26445; non-target muscles warm sand #D9CBBE with darker sand shading; skin and tendons ivory #F5F0E5; fine grey linework; black/grey/white realistic gym equipment. No green or sage.

Headline, huge, uppercase, stacked exactly as on the reference:
STRUCTURE (dark #2A2A2A)
THE PERFECT (dark #2A2A2A)
LEG DAY (coral #F26445)
Use the same line breaks, position, and scale as the reference. Do not clip or shorten any letters. Soft shadow as in the template.

Below the headline, show one bald, faceless, smooth-plastic anatomy mannequin seated on a black/grey plate-loaded hack squat machine, front three-quarter view, mid-rep with knees bent and shoulders under the pads. Featureless smooth pelvis, no genital detail. Quads are the only highlighted muscle group, filled flat coral #F26445; all other visible anatomy warm sand/ivory. Machine structure and loaded plates clearly recognizable. Figure and machine occupy the lower half and are naturally cropped by the bottom edge as in the template. Premium fine-line educational anatomy illustration, same body proportions and finish as approved series master.
slides.export_method: Uniform fit to 1080x1350 without independent-axis stretch; exact Lightweight wordmark pixels composited from approved LW-CAR-0001 slide 1.

slides.prompt:
Create ONE finished original Lightweight carousel slide, LW-CAR-0009 slide 2, using the attached owner-approved LW-CAR-0002 slide 2 as the exact layout template. Match its left-aligned two-line headline, short coral underline, five vertically spaced bullet rows with round dark bullets, partial figure composition in the bottom right, off-white background, pale arch, wordmark position, type scale, linework and hierarchy. Output one portrait 4:5 slide, no border, caption, watermark, signature or other words.

Series palette: #F0F1EB background, pale arch #FBE3DD, coral #F26445, dark #2A2A2A, body grey #6B6B6B, warm sand muscles #D9CBBE, darker sand shading, ivory #F5F0E5 skin/tendons, thin grey anatomy outlines. Use Rubik. Leave the exact top-left wordmark area clear for logo pixels from the supplied approved master; do not invent a logo.

At upper left, large bold dark title, exactly two lines:
“Your Leg Day”
“Should Include:”
Below it, a short coral horizontal underline, same as template.

Under title, five dark round bullet dots and five left-aligned text rows. Preserve every string and punctuation exactly; use regular weight for “1x” and the parenthetical, bold weight only for the muscle name:
1x Quads (Squat Pattern)
1x Hamstrings (Hinge or Curl)
1x Glutes (Hip Extension)
1x Adductors (Inner Thigh)
1x Calves
Do not omit bullets or alter capitalization. Keep all lines fully visible and evenly spaced.

Lower right, cropped by the right and bottom edges as in the template: a smooth-plastic anatomical mannequin lower body from waist to feet in three-quarter rear view, one leg slightly forward. Smooth featureless pelvis with no genital detail. Highlight quads, hamstrings, glutes, adductors and calves coral #F26445; all other visible muscles warm sand/ivory with fine grey linework. Use the established premium educational anatomy style. Keep the figure on the right so it does not cover any checklist text. No additional text or figures.
slides.export_method: Uniform fit to 1080x1350 without independent-axis stretch; exact Lightweight wordmark pixels composited from approved LW-CAR-0001 slide 1.
